scientific_integrity: Exact series and inequalities proved analytically by spherical lift parity and Funk-Hecke spectral analysis; deterministic finite checks and Monte Carlo are corroborating evidence, not infinite proofs. Classical harmonic analysis and flat-torus literature are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only standard curvature-one real projective plane; independent Haar-area vertices; almost surely unique minimizing geodesic edges; loops may self-intersect. The historical-priority comparison remains provisional; no statements for nonround metrics or arbitrary manifolds.
title: Exact homotopy spectrum of random shortest-geodesic polygons on the round projective plane
